profile.headline: Software Developer at Guidehouse
profile.summary: Goal-oriented programmer who finishes any project that is started in a quick and efficient manner. Proven ability to get the point of a project the first time it is told and use that point to finish said project as fast and as well-organized as possible. Fluent in three major programming languages and two minor but still important ones. Good communication skills to get a message across to other people and also to teach others of a particular subject. Powerful analysis skills to tell if something is going wrong the first time it is seen. Fully committed to providing and implementing dynamic, compelling solutions to the ongoing objectives of the organization.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Design, develop, and provide support for training and documentation for out of the box modules in Archibus for the US Department of State.

Participate on quarterly training sessions on client site, requiring travel to Arlington, Virginia, to ensure consistent implementation of Archibus modules and clarify requirements with client.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Design, develop, and provide support for custom views that tailors to multiple clients’ needs using Archibus’s built-in frameworks and axvw files.
Design, develop, and provide support for custom workflow rules in Java that transforms data in a way the client needs it to be transformed. This includes, but is not limited to, checking if the data received will be processed correctly.
Maintain clients’ data using SQL server to make sure custom views and workflow rules run without any issues.
Create and maintain solution designs and work-based structures for all changes requested by client to keep track of them in case changes need to be made in the future and/or client or PM needs to know why a certain decision was made.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Design and develop applications that facilitate the sales, purchases, and customer service processes of the company.
•	Maintain such applications if any updates need to be applied such as new marketplaces or tracking mechanisms.
•	Provide new technologies for better sales such as automatic tracking emails or email notifications in case something goes wrong.
•	Develop and maintain website that tracks orders movements from when a customer ordered a product to when said order is delivered to the customer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design tailored applications and web sites for small and medium businesses with specific problems, mainly sales points with a strong emphasis on reading weighing machines.
•	Develop applications to be ran on different computers connected via a server using relational data bases.
•	Use new technologies to make the most efficient application, be it computer or web, to meet users’ requirements, manly the .NET Mainframe along with MySQL for applications and HTML5 and CSS3 for web sites.
•	Provide Tech Support for said applications on any issue the user is having or any questions they have about said applications.
•	Strong emphasis on Agile development to make sure every requirement is met in the allotted time limit.

Online sales manager.

projects.title: ERP Website
projects.description:
ERP website created with PHP and MySQL that tracks the current status of an item that was ordered from us.

This site tracks everything from checking if we have the item in stock or we have to order it from our provider, check if we have to pay our provider, send an email to said provider with a proof of payment, and send emails to customers letting them know we sent their order and/or it was delivered.

This is still an ongoing project that is been updated constantly for fluctuating company's needs. Changes include:
Integrated sales point for bookstore
Monthly expense logs
Daily sales reports

projects.title: CloWork Project Care
projects.description: Responsible for contributing in the development of a website, database, and mobile app that is targeted towards hospitals in Africa that are suffer poor to no wifi.  It will allow users to schedule appointments, update/view information, allow staff/doctors to view their patients information without the need to be connected to wifi.  Will also allow automatic updates of newly added information once the user is connected back to wifi.
